title: LAW OR GRACE? ⚖️🔥💧
paragraphs:
Moses brought stone.
Jesus brings Spirit.

One was written on tablets.
The other is written on hearts.

Are Christians under the Law?
Do we still keep the Old Testament commands?
Or did Jesus fulfill what we could never finish?

Some say grace cancels obedience.
Some say law defines holiness.

But what if grace doesn’t lower the standard…
What if it raises it — from behavior to the heart?

The Law says: “Do not.”
Grace says: “Become.”

The Law exposes sin.
Grace transforms sinners.

Here’s the real tension:
If you remove the Law, do you remove accountability?
If you cling to the Law, do you miss the Savior?

⚔️ Moses vs Jesus
🪨 Stone vs Spirit
📜 Commands vs Fulfillment
“For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.” — John 1:17

Are we under the Law…
or under Grace?
